result.boundary: Native pixel programmable distance and WPO distance debug control are covered for ordinary, CPU instanced and spline components. Pixel fallback disables mask/PDO while preserving vertex deformation and final material shading. Skinning, GPU-only instances, assemblies, curves, displacement, remaining materials/views, full-scene temporal reconstruction and performance remain open in the completion tracker.
